title: karpatiosorbus latifolia
intro: Karpatiosorbus latifolia, commonly known as Sorbus latifolia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This shrub or small tree is native to the mountainous regions of Central and Eastern Europe and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive problems, and support the immune system. Bioactive constituents of Karpatiosorbus latifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
